story.title: Colder?
story.ctaText: How many did you get? Comment 👇

lines.q: Which is colder in winter, the South Pole or the North Pole?
lines.a: The South Pole! It sits on a huge ice sheet, way up high.

lines.q: The average day on Mars, or the coldest day ever on Earth?
lines.a: Earth! Antarctica hit minus eighty nine in nineteen eighty three.
Yakutsk! The coldest big city on the planet.

lines.q: Last one. Liquid nitrogen, or deep space?
lines.a: Deep space! Just three degrees above absolute zero. Think you can get all four? Go again!
